[LADP.8.4.1] A service declaring `response T` names, in `T`, a `schema`
declared in the same library. The declaration's header carries the service's
dotted name (`<domain>.<method>`); the library identifier is implicit in the
file. `T` is a response schema and meets [LCRS.4.3.2]; a call's response is a
fact of `T` ([LCRS.4.3.1]), and rules read it as they read any fact
([LCRS.5.5]).
